title: The Blue Hour of the family house on Kessler Street
author: Jonah Kavanagh
blurb: Wren Vane, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
